notes.title: Version update & optimize experience & fix BUG
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428356/00a71f05baeaffc31b1b321762b2ff4e95bd5bb4.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Updated the ability to predict enemy actions during battle[/b]
([i]I think this feature is super cool![/i])

[*] [b]Optimized the playback speed and effects of the text to make it smoother[/b]
([i]After receiving feedback from everyone, I feel that it really needs to be optimized[/i])

[*] [b]Fixed a bug where some texts were displayed incorrectly[/b]
([i][strike]I don't know what it does, but the bug seems to mysteriously disappear[/strike][/i])

[*] [b]Fixed an issue where localized translations were not displaying correctly[/b]
([i]It's hidden too deep, and it's not the reason I wasn't careful enough...[/i])

[*] [b]Fixed an issue where display errors occurred when switching resolutions[/b]
([i]My brain is attacking me and telling me how to fix it...[/i])
[/list]

Thank you very much for your support
